{{Quote|The blue guards started telling everyone to clear the doors, and then people started shouting back. They [the protestors] tried to push back, and that's when the rifles came out.|Lia Reicheds|<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|55|news/1359_1.html|Anti-War Rally Dispersed by Senate Guard}}</ref>}}
The '''Mk II Paladin blaster rifle''',<ref name="EV" /> also simply just known as the '''Coruscant Senate Guard Blaster Rifle''',<ref name="BftG">''[[Star Wars: Battles for the Galaxy]]''</ref> was a model of [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] that was used by the [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guards]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="EV" />

==Description==
Commissioned by the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|galactic Senate]] for the use of the [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]], the Mk II Paladin was manufactured by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]]. This distinctive black-and-silver weapon was powerful and highly accurate in the right hands, and all Guardsmen were trained in rifle proficiency as new recruits. The blaster also carried a stun setting and a stun prod useful for crowd-control situations. Although designated as "ceremonial" weapons, these rifles saw increased use during the latter decades of the Republic's rule. Capable of both single-shot and rapid-fire, they were equipped with collapsible stocks.<ref name="EV" />

By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the rifles were largely stored in the armories deep within the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]]. A rare sight in the greater galaxy, some remained available as collectors items on the black market.<ref name="EV" />
